faq.a: Madina is associated with the Arabic form مَدِينَة, whose core sense is madina; city; medina.

faq.q: What is the origin of Madina?
faq.a: Madina is associated with Arabic. Madina is Arabic مَدِينَة (Madīna), meaning 'city'; it is the name of the city of Medina. It is used as a female given name.
Yes — the underlying form مَدِينَة is Arabic.
